meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Recommended Supplier 1 Email" empty

plan.title: Reject Proposal with Empty Recommended Supplier Email

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor B as required by the case.
Verify the full line is allocated to one vendor for the expected ₹900 proposal value.
Open the proposal form after allocating the award.
Confirm that the proposal form opened.

args.goal: fill every required proposal field except Recommended Supplier 1 Email, leave that field empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop on the proposal form showing its required-field validation

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately omitting the required email, then submit it.
Verify submission is refused and the omitted email field is highlighted with the required-field message.
